summary: Can-Fite BioPharma Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release about a Japanese patent allowance for its drug candidate Namodenoson for anti-obesity use. The filing does not involve any merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event. It is a routine foreign private issuer report of a patent milestone, with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics. As a standard intellectual property update, it falls outside special-situations categories. No risk-arb angle or regulatory clock is applicable.
